# Jeuxvideo.com — French player reviews

- Original title: Avis et critiques du jeu Robin Hood : La Légende de Sherwood sur PC
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.jeuxvideo.com/jeux/pc/jeu-9953/avis/)
- Author / publisher: Jeuxvideo.com readers, including LinusLatinus, oztral, and guigui32140
- Language / date: French; sampled reviews 2011–2024
- Access: Displayed review page inspected; other pages not surveyed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

LinusLatinus’s December 2011 review enjoys varied combat and room for pacifist play, while finding ambushes repetitive. oztral’s May 2012 review praises the adaptation and scenery but argues that rushing enemies with swords dominates infiltration. guigui32140’s January 2024 review likewise finds some companions awkward for a nonlethal approach.

These disagreements document different play styles rather than settling the mechanics. The page displayed 58 ratings with a sixteen-out-of-twenty average, but this is not a representative survey. One visible reviewer explicitly says they have not played the game, another reason to treat the aggregate cautiously.
